name: Radiation-Induced Disorder

criteria.description: Documented history of significant ionizing radiation exposure
Presence of characteristic clinical symptoms consistent with radiation injury
Exclusion of alternative diagnoses that could explain symptoms
Radiologic evidence of tissue damage consistent with radiation exposure

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: History of radiation exposure plus at least two major clinical criteria with exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical and supported by history and imaging; biopsy may be required in some cases.

pathognomonic.notes: Typically occurs in irradiated skin fields
Inflammatory reaction in lung tissue post-radiation

common.notes: Fibrotic tissue changes in irradiated areas
Inflammation of the intestines following abdominal radiation
Lens opacification due to radiation exposure
Thyroid gland dysfunction after neck irradiation

occasional.notes: Peripheral nerve damage in irradiated regions
Inflammation of the heart muscle post-radiation
Hair loss localized to irradiated scalp areas

rare.notes: Development of cancers such as leukemia or sarcoma post-radiation
Bone necrosis typically in the jaw following head and neck radiation
Vision loss due to optic nerve damage
searchTerms: vision loss from optic nerve damage by radiation

laboratory: Elevated inflammatory markers (e.g., ESR, CRP) in acute phases
Cytopenias in radiation-induced bone marrow suppression
imaging: Radiographic evidence of fibrosis or tissue necrosis in irradiated areas
CT or MRI showing radiation pneumonitis or enteritis
genetic: No specific genetic markers; susceptibility may be influenced by DNA repair gene polymorphisms
other: Histopathology showing fibrosis, necrosis, or atypical cellular changes in affected tissues

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of infectious agents on culture or biopsy

redFlags: Rapidly progressing tissue necrosis in irradiated area
Development of secondary malignancy in radiation field
Severe respiratory distress due to radiation pneumonitis
references: Radiation-Induced Injury: Pathophysiology and Management, Journal of Clinical Oncology, 2023
Radiation Toxicity and Its Management, Lancet Oncology, 2022
